name: Dimensity 9600M
summary: The chip in the standard vivo X500 and OPPO Find X10, below the Dimensity 9600 Pro and built on a 3 nm process. MediaTek's full specifications were not in the launch reports read; no test results yet.

default.note: 3 nm process from SoyaCincau's and Zing Gadget's vivo X500 launch reports; used in the vivo X500 and OPPO Find X10.
